title: Yellowed Rich Moroccan Cheese Pastilla
description: A savory Moroccan dish featuring dark brown soft sugar and cheese, perfect for a sick day. This Jain-friendly pastilla is made with a mortar-pestle-pound filling and has a delicious cheese-pull.
instructions: In a mortar, pound the green chili peppers and dark brown soft sugar until well combined.
Add the chopped parsley and cilantro to the mortar and pound until well combined.
In a large bowl, combine the shredded mozzarella cheese and crumbled feta cheese.
Add the pounded mixture to the cheese and mix until well combined.
Layer the phyllo dough in a large baking dish, brushing each layer with olive oil.
Add the cheese mixture to the phyllo dough and fold the dough over the filling to form a pastilla.
Brush the top of the pastilla with olive oil and bake for 35 minutes.
Remove the pastilla from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
